citation.authors: Høeg LD, Sjøberg KA, Jeppesen J, et al.
citation.title: Lipid-Induced Insulin Resistance Affects Women Less Than Men and Is Not Accompanied by Inflammation or Impaired Proximal Insulin Signaling

population.description: Eight women and eight men, 'young well-matched healthy' (abstract), moderately fit, eumenorrheic women not on oral contraceptives and studied in the midfollicular phase (days 7-11); informed consent, Copenhagen ethics. Table 1 (means +/- SE, n = 8 per sex): age 25 +/- 1 in both sexes; sd = SE x sqrt(8) = 1 x 2.83 = 2.83, computed here (the SE is printed as a whole number, so this is coarse). BMI is printed per sex only (women 21.5 +/- 0.5, men 23.5 +/- 0.5), so it is null here and stated on each arm.

protocols.name: w_preclamp
protocols.description: Women, saline (control) trial, n = 8: 5 h of saline infusion (1.15 ml/kg/h) to the preclamp sample at 300 min; breakfast (20% of daily energy, size not printed, so not entered) was given at 05:00, 3 h before the experiment started, so 08:00 and 3 h fasted at minute 0, 8 h at the sample. Age 25 +/- 1 SE, BMI 21.5 +/- 0.5 SE (Table 1); sd = SE x sqrt(8) = 2.83 and 1.41.

protocols.name: m_preclamp
protocols.description: Men, saline (control) trial, n = 8: 5 h of saline infusion (1.15 ml/kg/h) to the preclamp sample at 300 min; breakfast (20% of daily energy, size not printed, so not entered) was given at 05:00, 3 h before the experiment started, so 08:00 and 3 h fasted at minute 0, 8 h at the sample. Age 25 +/- 1 SE, BMI 23.5 +/- 0.5 SE (Table 1); sd = SE x sqrt(8) = 2.83 and 1.41.

protocols.name: w_clamp
protocols.description: Women, saline (control) trial, n = 8: 5 h of saline infusion (1.15 ml/kg/h) ; as the preclamp arm, then a 120-min euglycaemic hyperinsulinaemic clamp from 300 to 420 min (insulin bolus 9.0 mU/kg then 1.42 mU/kg/min). Clamp levels are the end-of-clamp (420 min) control-trial values measured in women (Table 2): arterial blood glucose 5.4 mmol/l, plasma insulin 87.7 uU/ml (text: arterial insulin about 90 uU/ml in both sexes). Breakfast at 05:00, size not printed, not entered; 3 h fasted at minute 0 (08:00). Age 25 +/- 1 SE, BMI 21.5 +/- 0.5 SE (Table 1); sd = SE x sqrt(8) = 2.83 and 1.41.

protocols.name: m_clamp
protocols.description: Men, saline (control) trial, n = 8: 5 h of saline infusion (1.15 ml/kg/h) ; as the preclamp arm, then a 120-min euglycaemic hyperinsulinaemic clamp from 300 to 420 min (insulin bolus 9.0 mU/kg then 1.42 mU/kg/min). Clamp levels are the end-of-clamp (420 min) control-trial values measured in men (Table 2): arterial blood glucose 5.1 mmol/l, plasma insulin 94.3 uU/ml (text: arterial insulin about 90 uU/ml in both sexes). Breakfast at 05:00, size not printed, not entered; 3 h fasted at minute 0 (08:00). Age 25 +/- 1 SE, BMI 23.5 +/- 0.5 SE (Table 1); sd = SE x sqrt(8) = 2.83 and 1.41.
